correspondence.review_quote: weijinqian0 建议使用 `log` 替代 `print` 输出警告信息。kunpengW-code 指出 UT 触发规则需要同步修改。作者通过 commit `d55a4dc` 将 print 改为 log，并同步更新了测试配置。

rule.description: 在 Python 代码中应使用 `logger.warning()` 而非 `print(..., file=sys.stderr)` 输出警告信息，以保持日志格式一致性并支持日志级别控制。
checkpoints: 检查是否使用 `print` 输出警告信息
确认是否使用了项目统一的 logger
验证日志级别是否正确（warning/error/info）

antipattern.code:
import os
import sys

from importlib.metadata import version


def check_triton_ascend_version_valid() -> bool:
    """
    Check triton-ascend version and warn about UVA feature disablement.
    """
    DISABLE_UVA_VERSION = "3.2.1"
    installed_version = version("triton-ascend")
    if installed_version == DISABLE_UVA_VERSION:
        warning_msg = (
            f"WARNING: triton-ascend {DISABLE_UVA_VERSION} "
            f"disables the UVA feature.\n"
            f"Related bug issue: https://github.com/"
            f"triton-lang/triton-ascend/issues/783"
        )
        print(warning_msg, file=sys.stderr)
        return False
    return True


def is_uva_available() -> bool:
    """check if uva feature is supported in this environment"""
    return ("pinned_mem_register:True" in os.environ.get(
        "PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF", {})
            and check_triton_ascend_version_valid())

pattern.code:
import os
import sys

from importlib.metadata import version
from logging import getLogger

logger = getLogger(__name__)


def check_triton_ascend_version_valid() -> bool:
    """
    Check triton-ascend version and warn about UVA feature disablement.
    """
    DISABLE_UVA_VERSION = "3.2.1"
    installed_version = version("triton-ascend")
    if installed_version == DISABLE_UVA_VERSION:
        warning_msg = (
            f"WARNING: triton-ascend {DISABLE_UVA_VERSION} "
            f"disables the UVA feature.\n"
            f"Related bug issue: https://github.com/"
            f"triton-lang/triton-ascend/issues/783"
        )
        logger.warning(warning_msg)
        return False
    return True


def is_uva_available() -> bool:
    """check if uva feature is supported in this environment"""
    return ("pinned_mem_register:True" in os.environ.get(
        "PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF", "")
            and check_triton_ascend_version_valid())
